Hyehyɛ Hijri da bi na hwɛ Arafah, An-Nahr ne Tashreeq nna no
Hyehyɛ Hijri da a ɛfata. Afe fi 1300 kosi 1600, ɔsram fi 1 kosi 12, da fi 1 kosi 30.

Hyehyɛ Hijri da biara (anaasɛ sie mprempren da no) na woanya Hajj nna a ɛwɔ n’afe no mu ntɛm ara: Arafah Da (9 Dhul-Hijjah), An-Nahr Da (10 Dhul-Hijjah) ne Tashreeq Da (11, 12 ne 13 Dhul-Hijjah), a emu biara wɔ ne Gregorian pɛpɛɛpɛ ne ne gyinabea a ɛfa wo da no ho.
Odum kɛseɛ: gyina Arafah firi awia akyi kɔsi owia kɔtɔ, yɛ nkotɔsrɛ pii, takbir ne tahlil. Anabi (PBUH) kaa sɛ: "Hajj yɛ Arafah."
Eid al-Adha: fa aboɔden aboɔ ason to Jamarat al-Aqabah, bɔ afɔdeɛ no, yiyi anaa twitwa, afei yɛ Tawaf al-Ifadah ne Sai.
Da biara da amanneɛbɔ a ɛkae wo amanne a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ wɔ ne bere mu wɔ Hajj nna mu (8–13 Dhul-Hijjah) .
Da biara da amanneɛbɔ a ɛkae wo amanne a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ wɔ ne bere mu wɔ Hajj nna mu (8–13 Dhul-Hijjah) .
Saa da yi sunnah: hyɛn ihram mu, fa w’ani kyerɛ Mina na da anadwo wɔ hɔ, san ka Talbiyah "Labbayk Allahumma labbayk", na bɔ mpaeɛ wɔ hɔ a wɔatwa no tiaa a wɔmfa nkabom.
Aboɔ Jamarat abiɛsa no awiabere akyi: nketewa, afei mfinimfini, afei akɛse, abotan ason a emu biara reka takbir, srɛsrɛ nketewa ne mfinimfini no akyi.
Tashreeq nna: da a ɛtɔ so 1 (11 Dhul-Hijjah) .

Tia abo a wɔde bɛtow Jamarat abiɛsa no wɔ awiabere akyi sɛnea nnɛra no. Obiara a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ ntɛm no betumi afi Mina ansa na owia akɔtɔ; obiara a ɔbɛtena hɔ no, ɔda anadwo no na ɔbɔ aboɔ da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no.
Tashreeq nna: da a ɛtɔ so mmienu (12 Dhul-Hijjah) .
Aboɔ Jamarat abiɛsa no wɔ awiabere akyi, afei fa akwaaba Tawaf no wie Hajj no bere a worefi Makkah no. Allah nnye wo Hajj nnye.
Tashreeq nna: da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa (13 Dhul-Hijjah) .

Hajj ne Umrah ho nsɛm a ɛkɔ akyiri: nkyerɛaseɛ ne atemmuo, amanne ahodoɔ, mawaqit, amanneɛ no anammɔn anammɔn ne wɔn nyansa ne deɛ wɔbɛka wɔ gyinabea biara, ihram a wɔabara, ne nkotɔsrɛ. Paw ɔfã a wopɛ sɛ wohwehwɛ mu no.

Ɔkɔmhyɛni صلى الله عليه وسلم kaa sɛ: “Allah wɔ din aduɔkron nkron, ɔha ka ho, obiara a ɔbɛkan wɔn no bɛkɔ Paradise.” Klik edin biara so na kenkan ne nkyerɛkyerɛmu, ne nteaseɛ ne ne adanseɛ nyinaa firi Kur’aan no mu.
